name: Fresh Home
author: Vansh Bhardwaj
description: Fills Home: new releases from the artists you play, a radio from the last artist you played, the top songs and albums of your country, and mood and genre playlists. Play counts stay on this phone; the catalogues are only asked by artist name.
changelog: A support link: a line in the settings page, and after a month one hideable line on Home about the Ko-fi page. Nothing else changed.

actions.name: home.sections
actions.why: Shows new releases, a radio, charts and moods at the end of Home

actions.name: playback.events
actions.why: Counts which artists you play, to find their new releases

actions.name: storage
actions.why: Keeps those counts and the shelves on this phone

actions.name: settings.page
actions.why: Your country, moods, artists to follow and which shelves to show

actions.name: network
actions.why: Asks Apple and Deezer for releases, charts, radios and playlists

settings.label: Country
settings.description: Whose charts and store to use. Auto follows the app's language, else the United States.

settings.label: Artists to follow
settings.description: Comma-separated. Their new releases show even before you play them.

settings.label: New means released in the last
Refresh now
settings.description: Asks the catalogues again (it also happens by itself every 6 hours).

settings.label: Support Fresh Home
settings.description: Free and open source. If it helps you, a coffee keeps updates coming: ko-fi.com/vanshmusic

settings.label: Forget my artists
settings.description: Clears the play counts kept on this phone.

welcome.message: Fresh Home adds two sections at the end of Home: what's new from your artists, and what's popular where you are.
steps: Play a few songs: the artists you play are counted on this phone.
Optional: pick your country and add artists to follow in this extension's settings.
